open_decision: When the owner pid is unknown and the known age equals stale_after exactly, the laws do not say whether to remove the lock file.
result_a: true (remove): the design that uses age >= staleAfter, as ref does
result_b: false (keep): the design that uses age > staleAfter
reason: UnknownOlderRemoved needs a strictly greater than staleAfter and UnknownYoungerKept needs a strictly less than staleAfter, so age equal to staleAfter has no law. Both designs pass all seven laws and differ only at this boundary.
